you can right click to generate one nearby.

English:
Works like a normal sprinkler that will auto harvest and replant.
The effect range is 16 x 16.
Will not work without a Verdant Crystal placed.

Green Gem - Faster growing (1:10%)
Blue Gem - Extra harvest (1:10%, Each independent judgment)
Red Gem - Gold chance (1:3%)

蓝-额外收成（1:10%，每颗独立判定）
红-金色几率（1:3%）
